title: Entertainment browsing interface
slide_intent: Separate featured content from browsing categories so viewers can resume a selection or explore alternatives quickly.
strategic_value: A coherent browsing hierarchy can connect Xfinity’s service identity with access to varied entertainment brands.
demonstration: A television interface places a large resume-watching tile above a row of colored service tiles, with navigation labels between the two levels.
practical_value: Give the primary content choice more area while keeping category labels and service alternatives easy to scan.

content_islands.name: Interface header
content_islands.spec: Place the Xfinity wordmark at upper left and time and weather at upper right on a dark surface.

content_islands.name: Featured content row
content_islands.spec: Show the largest resume-watching image at left with smaller neighboring content tiles.

content_islands.name: Service browsing row
content_islands.spec: Align colored category labels and provider tiles below, maintaining separation from the featured content.

content_islands.name: Presentation field
content_islands.spec: Frame the dark television with the purple outer field and a restrained shadow.

reference_purposes.Expression: A dark interface balances bright category colors and entertainment imagery.
reference_purposes.Application: The hierarchy is demonstrated in a television content-browsing screen.
